title: New jobs, made reliable
subtitle: Two jobs an engineering agent made reliable, and an instrument it built for a fleet
notes: Final cut 2: final cut 1 (reliability-final-1-2026-10-20.json, b50d84e, rendered as final-1, kept unchanged) with the review's three repairs: the opening says the agent improves the installation around it; job 2's experiment is split into r2-loaded (cheese loaded into the bowl, e001301, the count stated as deliveries) and r2-relocated (cheese grasped, slid aside and released, e001501, shown while that sentence is read, then the plate and bowl). Final reliability cut 1 (robots-qzfk.44.5). Story A: two new jobs, each with request, visible failure, the agent's experiment, release on reserved starts beside the plain chain, and what the library keeps. Job 1, replacement-01 (bowl on the cabinet, middle drawer open): 20 of 20 against 1 of 20, 19 rescued, 0 broken. Job 2, plate-cabinet-01 (plate at the stove front, bowl on the cabinet): 20 of 20 against 5 of 20, 15 rescued, 0 broken. Both without an order rule; both receipts reconciled episode by episode in each cohort's coordinator-verification.json. Release pairs: the first rescued reserved start of each by `python -m fleetlab.film pairs`, initial state 31 in both (job 1 e000202 against e000102, job 2 e000202 against e000102), verified 720px scene re-renders. Development footage is original 360px at a frame every fourth control step: job 1 practice start 2 (e000503 against e000603, session 3); job 2 practice start 1 (plain chain e000102, session 1, its plate step timing out) and practice start 0 (cheese loaded e001301, session 4, against cheese set aside e001501, session 5), both chosen as the first start the saved procedure rescued by `film pairs`. Job 2's reserved plain chain fails differently from its development clip: it reaches the plate goal at step 145 and its bowl step times out at 445 with both goals false; the narration says so and keeps the two apart. Story B, unchanged in its results and fields: the fleet figure, the agent's probe, the reserved-panel figure and the evaluation's counts, as in the pitch and final cuts. Request excerpts on screen are the first two sentences of each request_text, verbatim (checked as exact prefixes); the check cards are labelled summaries; the skill excerpts are line 3 of each SKILL.md, verbatim. Frames show no run ids or digests (sources_on_screen viewer); provenance.json keeps them. No new run, nothing re-shot, no host-screen footage or result.
